{{Top|leg}}
A '''jumper clip''' was a tool used to connect electrical circuits.<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

During an information raid on a mining operations center, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used a jumper clip to modify a junction within a junction box while assisting [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] team in their search for a new potential location for the Alliance's next base.<ref name="COO" />
